rationale: The last candle shows an enormous volume spike (1.39M shares in one minute) with price surging from $18.25 to $18.39, pushing the stock to the absolute top of its intraday range with essentially zero distance to the high. This kind of climactic volume burst at range extremes with no news catalyst makes both long (chasing a potential exhaustion top) and short (fighting strong momentum with no clear reversal confirmation) unattractive. The wide bid-ask spread and ambiguous post-spike direction warrant waiting for the dust to settle before committing capital.
